notes.title: Update News
notes.notes:
Updated May 16

1. New Song "Dream Of Winds BMS Ver. by LOVE™" is added.
2. When [Cruise Control] in mission mode is activated, "FIXED NOTE SPEED" option will not be applied.
3. The song sort options are now saved.
4. "Airlock" MV quality is improved.
5. "Chemical Slave" has been changed to TAPSONIC series song.
6. "BlueWhite" EXPERT pattern has been partially modified.
7. On some initialization errors, the message box is exposed.

+ A list of streamers who have played the game is displayed on the title screen.

: D

notes.title: Urgent patch for Unlimited loading issue. (Second fix)
notes.notes:
Our tech guys found the reason that caused infinite loading after splash logo screen.

This update is for non-English language Windows users.
Please update to 2018-12-10 version if you are experiencing this issue.

Thanks.

notes.title: Second minor update - bug fix
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.

 Unlimited loading after game launch. (First fix)
 Infinite Loading issue when after splash title scenes.
 Various issues on the select music scenen after the result screen.
 The volume values changed in the settings are played abnormally.
 Note speed and difficulty settings is not saved.
 Excessive use of system resources. (Limited to 240 fps)
 Other minor bugs fixes.
